A deleted card frees its key for reuse. Local run had one unrelated failure (chatHandlers.folder symlinkSync on Windows); CI green.

outputs.summary: Desktop-only Kanban card deletion, merged to main via PR #20 (merge commit 418e2c1). New deleteKanbanCard command behind a human-only kanban.delete capability (agents get unauthorized; no MCP tool). It removes the card rows, attempts, events, pending outbox, sync state, cached idempotency replies and the tracked .darkmechanicus/kanban/<cardId>/ folder in one transaction, and refuses while an attempt is claimed, running or submitted. The card panel has a Delete button with a Keep/Delete confirmation, disabled with an explanation while an attempt is in flight. Note: this attempt was claimed after the Play flag was set directly in the database at the owner request, because the first claim token was lost (see DM-488).
